notes: Herringbone carbon nanofibers grown from ethylene on Fe/Ni/Cu catalysts (carbon yield 22-23 g/gcat, so carbon is the majority by mass; residual catalyst metal present). Uptakes 1.66-6.54 wt% (Table 1) and uptake-vs-time curves (Figure 3) measured by a differential-pressure volumetric method at 12 MPa, ambient temperature (298 K). BET (N2, 77 K) areas 34 and 51 m2/g in Table 1; text says argon treatment changed areas by roughly 15%, so the tabulated areas may not correspond exactly to the Ar-treated samples. A commercial MmNi4.5Al0.5 alloy was measured only as an instrument check. Electrochemical storage in CNFs is mentioned only as other work from the laboratory (ref. 42, in preparation), with no data in this paper. No statement that the uptake values were published before (ref. 31 is cited for the apparatus only). Not a review; record not flagged retracted and the PDF carries no retraction notice.
